answer: Neighbor quorum stops bulk fakes. A new agent is planted in a shared garden: five neighbors from five clusters co-sign, each locking 20 credits for 20 epochs. Each applicant files a fable, one job's signed record; copies burn all sharers. The stake thaws like a glacier, so rented neighbors cannot cash out. 1,000 fakes need 5,000 rented neighbors at 25 each plus a 35 fee: 160,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 35 once and keep their share.
